title: Conditional Shield 3 static ability is not implemented — the parser emits the second ability as {type:'static', effect:{type:'raw', text:'I have [Shield 3] while I'm at a battlefield with exactly one other unit you control.'}} and the engine ignores 'raw' statics.
expected: Ran the real card registry (getCardRegistry() from packages/riftbound-cards/src/data/all-cards.ts) for ven-117-166: enrichCards re-parses rulesText and yields abilities = [{keyword:'Hidden',type:'keyword'}, {type:'static', effect:{type:'raw', text:"I have [Shield 3] while I'm at a battlefield with exactly one other unit you control."}}] — no condition, no grant-keyword. In the engine, recalculateStaticEffects (packages/riftbound-engine/src/abilities/static-abilities.ts:715-743) only admits effect types in PASS_1_EFFECTS {grant-keyword, grant-keywords} and PASS_2_EFFECTS {modify-might}; a 'raw' effect is filtered out at lines 737-743 (`passEffects.length === 0 -> continue`), so no Shield keyword is ever granted. No card-specific override exists (JSON_CARD_ENGINE_FLAGS at all-cards.ts:802-822 has no ven-117-166 entry; grep for ven-117/Disciple in engine and app finds nothing). Hence Disciple of Shen never gets Shield 3 and defends at 1 might, matching the observed behavior.
observed: game.state(disciple).keywords == ['Hidden'] only (no Shield) both alone and with exactly one other friendly unit; in the engine-harness combat probe both defenders went to trash and the 4-might attacker conquered bf1 (defenders counted 1+1=2). Live client state also exposes no Shield grant.
